book.title: Nordnorsk kulturhistorie
book.summary: Special local culture and tradition in three northern counties has undergone much pressure in 1970s and 1980s. Vol. 1, Det gjenstridige landet (The stubborn land), has chapters on: its hard identity, nature as resource and framework for life, human life from Ice Age to present and cradle to grave, political and economic integration through a thousand years, religious, political and ethnic mobilisation 1850-1990, agriculture, fisheries, reindeer-herding and industry 1890-1990, late-modern times and myths of Northland through the ages. Vol. 2, Det mangfoldige folket (The diverse people), is divided into: impact of housing on people and vice versa, origins in islands, shore and inland, work, language, people and Powers, government and the impact of outside culture and love of home.
